summary: Iteration 3 (UI/UX redesign regression + new dashboards). Backend: new pytest suite test_redesign_dashboards.py, 22/22 passing. It covers /api/board (KPIs match the rows, date, city/q/status/active filters, sort, pagination, xlsx, invalid date 400, no-user 401/403), /api/overview (14-day series ending 2026-11-20, outstanding = expected - verified, pending count matches accounts summary), /api/transactions (old list mode still works, paged {items,total} with no overlap between pages, amount sort, date range + status, q search, xlsx), all 6 reports plus the city filter, xlsx export and staff 403, and the core flow (staff submit with upload -> board shows pending -> staff cannot approve (403) -> accounts approve -> board shows verified; reject with empty remarks 422 -> notification -> resubmit -> pending -> audit trail). Frontend (Playwright, 1920 and 390): every sidebar nav item routes and the header title updates. Role visibility is correct (staff sees only Overview/All Drivers/Calendar/Ledger + Settings/Help). Collapse works (236->68px) and survives a reload. Default landing is admin->/overview, staff->/board, accounts->/verification. The Overview KPIs and recharts trend render. All Drivers: date prev/next/picker/Today work (Today is disabled on today), the URL ?date syncs, the 8 KPIs show and change with the date and city filter, search, city/status/active filters and the staff options work, sort-daily_rent desc is correct, board-export downloads route39_all_drivers_<date>.xlsx, and a row click opens /calendar?driver=..&month=... Global search opens the driver's calendar. Core UI flow on Karthik Raja: staff adds payments on 15 and 16 Nov (vehicle select CHN-002, amount, UTR, screenshot preview) -> cells turn Pending and a toast shows. A future date (25 Nov) does not open a dialog. Accounts: summary cards, sort-amount asc/desc, pager on the All tab (25/43 -> page 2). Screenshot viewer: zoom in 150%, zoom out 125%, fit 100%, fullscreen (DIV), download of TXN-xxx_UTR.png. Approve confirmation -> cell Verified. Reject is disabled until remarks are entered -> reason shown -> staff notification -> Correct & Resubmit dialog with the rejection banner -> cell Pending. Ledger: pager, ledger-search, driver search plus clear, From/To popover calendars (shadcn), status/city/staff filters, Clear, sort, ledger-export xlsx, row -> detail with audit trail. Reports: KPIs and chart, all 6 report previews, report-city (verified 24 -> Chennai 1), export, admin Audit Log tab. Management: drivers search/city/status filters, add + edit dialogs; vehicles search/status filter, add + edit dialogs; staff role filter + search + add dialog; all pagers render. Settings: profile card, admin rule switches present, hidden for staff. Help renders. At 390px there is no horizontal overflow on overview/board/calendar/history/settings/help, the mobile sheet navigates and closes, and the payment dialog fits the screen. No functional regressions found.

minor.issue: kpis.verified sums verified amounts over all rows (including drivers who are not eligible, e.g. inactive or before rent start), while kpis.expected/outstanding use eligible rows only. This can make the collected % inconsistent. KPIs also ignore the status/staff_id filters but apply the q/city/active filters. That may be intentional; please document or align.
Every call loads all drivers and the day's transactions and paginates in Python. Fine at 8 drivers, but it will not scale to large fleets.

issues: The 'From'/'To' labels sit inline at the bottom-left of the date buttons, while the 'City' label sits above its select. The alignment is inconsistent.
The global driver search (md:block) and page title (sm:block) are hidden on mobile, so mobile users have no global search. Consider adding a search icon button that opens the search.
Some seeded Cash rows show the screenshot icon (they have a file_id). This is data, not code, but it may confuse users.

action_items: Optional: align /api/board kpis.verified to eligible drivers (or document it)
Optional: fix the From/To label alignment and the '1 rows' pluralisation on the Reports filters
Optional: give mobile users a way to reach global driver search
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1104 lines. Consider splitting it into routers (transactions, reports, dashboards, drivers/vehicles).
Transaction ids use count + random % 1000 plus a collision loop. That works, but uuid/sequence counters would be cleaner.
Board/overview load whole collections into memory (to_list(20000/200000)). Use aggregation when the fleet grows.
Driver/Vehicle/Staff management paginate client-side (usePaged), while the board and ledger paginate server-side. That is acceptable at the current size.
